categories.title: Structures and materials data
categories.intro: Discover structures and published data through browser portals, repositories, papers, and licensed institutional resources. Inspect provenance before model construction.

resources.use_when: Use COD for openly downloadable experimental crystallographic records.
resources.first_human_action: Search COD by formula, elements, mineral, author, or diffraction metadata; inspect the record before downloading its CIF.
resources.inspect: Inspect record identity, composition, cell representation, provenance, method or experiment metadata, disorder or occupancy, and available downloads.
resources.bring_back: Bring back the cited record identifier, original downloaded object, retrieval date, and enough metadata to reconstruct the selection.

categories.title: Visual inspection and symmetry
categories.intro: Use viewers and crystallographic services to recognize cell, geometry, periodicity, orientation, symmetry, and conversion problems that parsers alone may not expose.

resources.use_when: Use VESTA to rotate, measure, change boundaries, and inspect structures or volumetric data.
resources.first_human_action: Open the actual CIF or volumetric file in VESTA, verify species and cell, rotate along meaningful directions, adjust periodic boundaries, and measure suspicious distances or angles.
resources.inspect: Inspect the actual structure, transformation, tolerance, orientation, geometry, warning, or visual feature relevant to the current decision.
resources.bring_back: Bring back the original input, exported result, settings or tolerances, and a note describing the visual or crystallographic decision.
resources.boundary: Human visual inspection can reveal model mistakes but does not replace numerical validation or convergence testing.
resources.link_label: Download VESTA and open its manual
resources.name: VESTA

resources.bring_back: Bring back the exact code/version identity, input files, execution command, output and restart lineage, and observable-specific checks.
